violation_type.title: Meal and Snack Service - Allow Children to Feed Themselves (26 TAC §746.3319(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Meal and Snack Service - Allow Children to Feed Themselves
violation_type.typical_finding: The 4-6 year old children were not given utensils for lunch and they were eating with their hands.   Meagan gave all of the children utensils when she entered the classroom at the end of the meal.
